input.command:
cat > /home/u/.claude/jobs/job/tmp/intent.edn <<'EDN'
{:format    :intent
 :goal      "Give nido's dashboard a reusable chat panel that talks to a coding agent over the Agent Client Protocol, rendered server-side with Datastar, and put it first in the component catalog's sidebar, where a person can pick an element of a scene and ask an agent to change it — seeing the change before anything lands."
 :done-when ["The catalog lists a chat panel block with scenes for: empty, the person's message, a streaming reply, a finished reply, a tool call collapsed and expanded, a permission request with Allow and Deny, and an error; the catalog test renders every one."
             "nido holds an ACP connection to claude-agent-acp that starts or resumes an agent session, sends a prompt, and relays message chunks, tool calls and permission requests to the panel as Datastar patches while they arrive."
             "On /_catalog, select mode outlines the hovered element and selecting one attaches a reference (block, scene, and an element path that is the same on every render of that scene) to the next message; the agent's prompt carries that reference with the person's words."
             "An edit the agent makes in its worktree shows in the catalog the person is looking at without anything landing on main; nothing a chat message does pushes, fast-forwards or lands."
             "bb nido:test is green and bb nido:design:check reports ok on the landed tip."]
 :context   "Spawned by ui-principles. The person reviews dashboard UI in /_catalog and today describes changes from screenshots the agent cannot see. They want targeted chat experiences inside nido; the catalog is the first use, the workstream pane and a question card come later."}
EDN
cd /home/u/Code/nido-worktrees/catalog-chat && bb --config bb.edn nido:workstream:entry:add :project nido :ws-id ws-20261113-b0e476 :kind intent :file /home/u/.claude/jobs/job/tmp/intent.edn 2>&1 | tail -5

content.text: Intent recorded. I need the person's call on which agent the catalog panel talks to before the design.

questions.question: Which agent should the catalog's chat panel talk to? (Context: I checked claude-agent-acp 0.107 — it CAN resume or load an existing Claude Code conversation by session id, and fork one. So a workstream pane can later talk to that workstream's own agent. But two processes driving the same conversation at once is unsafe, so attaching means taking over while the terminal is idle.)

options.label: Dedicated design session (Recommended)
options.description: First send creates one nido session (its own worktree + runtime) for catalog design work and starts an agent in it. Later sends, and a dashboard restart, resume that same conversation. Its edits are previewed from its runtime; landing stays a separate act.

options.label: New session per conversation
options.description: Each 'New chat' gets a fresh nido session and worktree. Cleaner isolation, but many worktrees and runtimes to tidy up.

options.label: Pick an existing session
options.description: The panel lists live nido sessions and resumes the chosen one's conversation. Most flexible, but tangles design requests with whatever that session is doing.

questions.question: Permission prompts: nido sessions skip permissions today. What should the panel's agent do?

options.label: Skip, with a deny list (Recommended)
options.description: Run like every nido session (bypass), but deny push/land commands (jj git push, bookmark set main, land:record) at the agent so nothing lands from a chat. The panel still renders a permission request as Allow/Deny when the agent asks one (e.g. leaving plan mode).

options.label: Ask for everything risky
options.description: Default mode: edits auto-accepted, but shell commands and other tools raise Allow/Deny in the panel. Safer, more clicking.
